faqs.a:
(a)
In the event any provision of this chapter conflicts with any provision of the laws
               of the State or the rules of the state licensing authority pertaining to the Colorado
               Liquor or Beer Codes as set forth in C.R.S. title 44, art. 3, 4, or 5, the provisions
               of state law or the rules of the state licensing authority shall govern.
(b)
Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the provisions of state law or rules are silent
               on a matter contained in this chapter, then this chapter shall govern.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018)
